title: 7 Common Mistakes People Make After a Car Crash
metaDescription: Avoid quick settlements, skipped medical care, and social media mistakes after a car accident. Educational guide from Accident Survival Guide.
excerpt: Why quick settlements, skipped medical care, and social media posts can hurt your recovery.

sections.heading: Mistake 1: Skipping medical care
paragraphs: Adrenaline can mask pain. Delayed treatment may hurt both your health and your documentation.

sections.heading: Mistake 2: Accepting a quick settlement
paragraphs: Early offers may not account for ongoing treatment. Take time to understand your expenses first.

sections.heading: Mistake 3: Posting on social media
paragraphs: Photos and comments about the crash or your activities can be misinterpreted later.

faq.question: Is the first insurance offer usually final?
faq.answer: Often no. Many claims involve ongoing medical care. Review offers carefully; this is not legal advice.
